description: Verify that on DHCPACK timeout (T2) the client moves to REBINDING and broadcasts DHCPREQUEST to 0xFFFFFFFF (RFC 2131 §4.4.5)
approach:
[Objective]
If the original server doesn't ACK by T2 (= 0.875 × lease), it might be down; the client falls back to broadcast so any server with the binding can respond. RFC 2131 §4.4.5 makes the broadcast destination the rule for REBINDING.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND.
2. T1 → RENEWING → renew DHCPREQUEST.
3. Tester silent (no ACK within T2-T1).
4. T2 → REBINDING → DHCPREQUEST
   • IPv4 dst_ip == 255.255.255.255   ← key check

[Pass condition]
REBINDING REQUEST's IPv4 dst_ip is the all-ones broadcast.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_rebinding_request_dst_not_broadcast — REBINDING REQUEST not broadcast.

verdicts.Pass: REBINDING REQUEST broadcast at T2 — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST after ACK
verdicts.Fail_no_rebinding_request: No DUT rebinding DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_rebinding_request_dst_not_broadcast: DUT rebinding REQUEST dst_ip is not broadcast
